performance_design.assessment: Suitable bounded unchanged-path comparison after these pre-run clarifications.
requirements: Warm each measured operation inside every fresh process; freeze batching, workloads, checkpoint inputs and pairing/statistic definitions before measurement.
Exclude import/startup from operation timings, or measure identical imports separately. Avoid competing heavy workers during paired measurements.
Verify numerical outputs and genuine checkpoint replay; attest resolved baseline/candidate module paths and frozen dependency hashes.
Use MAD diagnostically, not a MAD-ratio slowdown gate. Specify whether the 1.05 gate applies to paired timing ratios or ratios of aggregate timing statistics.
Report all 12 paired samples. Their p95 is a coarse sample statistic, not a precise population-tail or confidence guarantee.
Describe baseline source versus installed candidate accurately; do not claim installed-wheel-versus-installed-wheel equivalence.
